Peptide Pro

US-based vendor (Tennessee) · Founded December 2024· Scored August 2026· peptidepro.io

Peptide Pro is a Tennessee-based research peptide vendor founded in December 2024. Lab results are publicly accessible at peptidepro.io/lab-test, and the vendor claims testing covers purity, identity, endotoxins, and net content - a scope that would exceed many competitors if confirmed in actual COA documents. The testing laboratory is not named in public materials, which is the primary gap limiting the score. Credit card is accepted.

Scoring Notes
Testing lab not named in public materials
The specific third-party laboratory is not identified in any publicly accessible materials reviewed. An unnamed lab is the single largest gap in the VTS score. Without a named lab, a buyer cannot cross-check COA data against the lab's own records. If Peptide Pro names its testing laboratory publicly, the score would increase meaningfully in the Testing Practice and Traceability dimensions.
Endotoxin and net content testing claimed - verify before purchase
Peptide Pro's marketing states testing covers purity, identity, endotoxins, and net content. If the published COA documents confirm this scope, the completeness profile exceeds many competitors. Buyers should verify by reviewing an actual COA document before purchase.
Track record score will improve with time
Track record score reflects a less than two year operational history, not a quality concern. New operations have shorter longitudinal evidence bases regardless of current documentation standards. This score is expected to increase if practices remain consistent.
Sources: peptidepro.io (homepage, lab results at /lab-test, product pages) · barchart.com/story/news/29916177 (December 2024 company announcement) · peptides.org/peptide-pros-review.
